name: Hero Banner
description: Main hero banner with optional text, ctas, and layout styles

attribute_definition_groups.name: Banner Options
attribute_definition_groups.description: The layout options that the banner should use.

attribute_definitions.name: Banner Type
values: Text over Image or Solid Background
attribute_definitions.default_value: Text over Image or Solid Background
attribute_definitions.description: Defaults to 'Text over Image or Solid Background', see documentation for examples of all options.

attribute_definitions.name: Banner Height
attribute_definitions.description: Controls the height of the banner. Defaults to Medium.

attribute_definitions.name: Text Placement
attribute_definitions.description: Controls the placement of the text over the component. Defaults to Middle Center. For the 'Half and Half' layout, use any left or right placement.

attribute_definitions.name: Text Width
attribute_definitions.description: How wide the text container should be (tablet and desktop only). Default is 1/2 of the component width.

attribute_definitions.name: Mobile Text Position
values: Text below image on tablet and smaller
attribute_definitions.description: How should this content stack on smaller viewports. Defaults to Text in front of image.

attribute_definitions.name: Background Image
attribute_definitions.description: For faster load time, please use images under 500 KB.

attribute_definitions.name: Background Image Alt Text
attribute_definitions.description: Add alternative text for image, default is an empty string. See following to better understand what to write: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/images.html#alt

attribute_definitions.name: Background Class
attribute_definitions.description: Adds a class to the outermost container of the hero. Use this to set a background color if there is no image selected, it's using Half & Half layout, or if it stacks vertically on mobile. e.g. 'background--brand-secondary' See the Style Guide for more color options.

attribute_definitions.name: Background Link
attribute_definitions.description: Set this to make the entire hero a link. To use this to launch a video in a modal, enter the video's URL as an 'External' link type. YouTube, Vimeo and self-hosted MP4s are supported.

attribute_definitions.name: Container Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to the inner container of the component. Useful for overriding padding. e.g. 'p-0' See the Style Guide for more class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Color Theme
attribute_definitions.description: Controls the colors of the component. This will only add a background to the text block if the Text in Card layout is used. See documentation for examples. Defaults to Light theme with black text.

attribute_definitions.name: Textblock Background
attribute_definitions.description: Only applicable for Text in Card layout. Choose a background style for the textblock. Defaults to Semitransparent.

attribute_definitions.name: Textblock Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to override the default theme colors, e.g. 'background--light-gray'. See the Style Guide for color options. Note: This does not support semitransparent backgrounds.

attribute_definitions.name: Text alignment
attribute_definitions.description: Defaults to center text alignment. Controls alignment of the text within the text area on the banner.

attribute_definitions.name: Title Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to override the default title styles, e.g. 'h4'. See the Style Guide for class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Subtitle Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to override the default subtitle styles, e.g. 'text--yellow'. See the Style Guide for class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Buttons Class
attribute_definitions.description: Add a class to the buttons container, e.g. 'mt-4'. See the Style Guide for class options.

attribute_definitions.name: Button 1 Action
attribute_definitions.description: To use this button to launch a video in a modal, enter the video's URL as an 'External' link type. YouTube, Vimeo and self-hosted MP4s are supported.

attribute_definitions.name: Button 1 Style
attribute_definitions.description: Defaults to Primary button style

attribute_definition_groups.name: Animation Options
attribute_definition_groups.description: Animations are applied to each text and embedded element.

attribute_definitions.name: Text Animation
attribute_definitions.description: Select an option below to animate in the text elements when this Hero Banner is scrolled to on the page.

attribute_definitions.name: Text Animation Duration
attribute_definitions.description: Choose a duration for the animation to travel. Default is Medium. Short will make the animation more subtle and Long will make it more extreme.

attribute_definitions.name: Subtitle Animation Delay
attribute_definitions.description: Enter a number (in milliseconds) for the animation delay. Default is 300.

attribute_definitions.name: Title Animation Delay
attribute_definitions.description: Enter a number (in milliseconds) for the animation delay. Default is 300.

attribute_definitions.name: Embedded Asset Animation Delay
attribute_definitions.description: This will only apply if an embedded asset is used. Enter a number (in milliseconds) for the animation delay. Default is 0.

attribute_definitions.name: Body Animation Delay
attribute_definitions.description: Enter a number (in milliseconds) for the animation delay. Default is 300.

attribute_definitions.name: Buttons Animation Delay
attribute_definitions.description: Enter a number (in milliseconds) for the animation delay. Default is 300.

attribute_definitions.name: Play Text Animation Once Only
attribute_definitions.description: If selected, the animation will not reset when the user scrolls back to the top of the page.

attribute_definitions.name: Disable Mobile Animation
attribute_definitions.description: If selected, animation will only occur on desktop (lg breakpoint and up).
